project_context.purpose: EVD-0012の具体Passive Skill 68件について、EVD-0001のPlayer全7職Lv1～50期待Statsから各Passive Requirementを満たす職業と最低Lvを固定Evidence化する。
project_context.summary: 68 Passive × 7職 = 476組を照合。Framework Template 24件はRequirement未確定のため対象外。Battle/Simulationは実行しない。

current_focus.theme: EVD-0013 暫定Passive Skill 68件・Player職業別装備可能対応表
current_focus.goal: EVD-0012の具体Passive Skill 68件について、EVD-0001のPlayer全7職Lv1～50期待Statsから各Passive Requirementを満たす職業と最低Lvを固定Evidence化する。

history.message: Created EVD-0013 from EVD-0012 concrete Passive records and EVD-0001 Player expected Stats. Framework templates were excluded. No Source/Game Data modification and no Battle/Simulation execution.

authority_basis.equipability_rule: A Player job/level is equipable when every stat in passive.requirement is >= the required threshold. Record the minimum qualifying level within Lv1..50.
authority_basis.framework_template_rule: EVD-0012 framework_templates are excluded because their concrete Trigger Stat/Effect Stat Requirements are not fixed.
authority_basis.job_restriction_rule: No separate Job restriction is applied; only concrete Passive Requirement and EVD-0001 expected_stats are evaluated.
authority_basis.evidence_boundary: Establishes stat-threshold equipability only; does not prove runtime Passive execution, series-slot legality beyond requirement, or combat balance.
